In this study, we utilised density functional theory to analyse the structural, electrical, optical, elastic and thermoelectric properties of the nitrogen-based perovskite SrReN3.

Mechanically, SrReN3 has moderate stiffness (bulk modulus similar to 60 GPa, Young's modulus similar to 85 GPa) and reasonable ductility (Poisson's ratio approximate to 0.26), combining strength with flexibility.
